description: One file from the signed-in company's document archive (file_id from list_tender_files): its text, 20000 characters per call (pass next_offset as offset for the rest; a tender document copied in gives the text read from it), and a download link valid for 5 minutes. download_filename is the name it downloads under: a filled document downloads as its editable Word/Excel original, though filename ends in .pdf; pdf_download_url and pdf_filename then give its PDF. Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.
name: get_tender_file
title: Plik z archiwum
